\ flagship phase E: read BLOCK 13 back, recompute 2*i from BLOCK 4, count mismatches. Zero mismatches is the
\ paged-data round trip; a nonzero count is printed so a failure is never silent.
4 CONSTANT DATABLK
13 CONSTANT XFM
CREATE dw 0 , CREATE xw 0 , CREATE ei 0 , CREATE bad 0 ,
: DATA ( -- addr ) dw @ ;
: XB ( -- addr ) xw @ ;
: RUND ( -- ) DATABLK BLOCK dw ! XFM BLOCK xw ! 0 ei ! 0 bad !
  BEGIN ei @ 128 < WHILE
    ei @ DATA + C@ 2 * 255 AND   ei @ XB + C@   <
    IF bad @ 1 + bad ! THEN
    ei @ 1 + ei ! REPEAT ;
: RUNE ( -- ) RUND bad @ . ;
RUNE
